title: Temple Theme Kit inner pages, group C: Programs as a TempleKitInner block and page
detail: One block type (TempleKitInnerPrograms, cards the Space types: line above, name, teacher, summary, price, badge, link), a three-column card grid in the group B sheet (inner-b-css.ts, tokens only) and the Programs page builder (components/sites/temple-kit-inner/pages-c.ts) for the design's Programs index. No rating, enrolment count or run date is seeded; the program landing and lesson player are the app's, not the kit's. Registration (block map, sheet, pages) belongs to the Temple kit registration pass. Shop, Library and Book follow under LIVE-1687 to 1689.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("components/page-editor/blocks/temple-kit-inner-c.tsx","utf8");if(!t.includes("TempleKitInnerPrograms:")){console.error("the Temple Kit Programs block is missing");process.exit(1)}'
